name: Full Day Off
title: Take a full weekend day off.
benefit: Better energy and output the following week.
subtitle: Weekly Recovery
rationale: A genuine day away from work raises the following week's output when the previous stretch has drained it.

evidence.summary: Psychological detachment from work supports recovery, well-being, sleep, and subsequent task performance.

indications: Records show off-day work that cost more downstream output than it produced.
Fatigue accumulates across uninterrupted work weeks.
